metadata.title: Sanad
metadata.description: A calm peer-support community for people living with chronic conditions.

hero.title: You’re not alone on this journey.
hero.subtitle: Sanad is a calm space for people living with chronic conditions to share their stories, find others who understand, and get through the hard days together.
hero.socialProof: People sharing and listening every day.
hero.imageAlt: A woman with her eyes closed, resting peacefully among leaves under a warm sun

howItWorks.title: A little support, in your own way

checkIn.title: Check in daily
checkIn.body: Say how you’re feeling in seconds. Private by default.

share.title: Share your story
share.body: Write about a hard stretch or a small win. Others respond with I relate or Sending support.

circle.title: Find your circle
circle.body: Join communities around shared experiences and chat live with people who understand.

stories.title: Real journeys, told by the people living them.

maya.name: Maya
maya.title: The year I stopped apologizing for cancelled plans
maya.excerpt: I used to explain every change of plan. Slowly, I learned that resting needs no apology.

omar.name: Omar
omar.title: A small walk, a bigger victory
omar.excerpt: Some days, progress looks different. Today, it was getting outside for ten quiet minutes.

lina.name: Lina
lina.title: Finding people who understand
lina.excerpt: I didn’t need someone to fix everything. I needed someone who understood the hard days.

conversations.title: Small conversations can make a big difference.
conversations.subtitle: A place to share, to listen, and to feel understood.
conversations.imageAlt: Two cups of tea on a sunlit wooden table beside a window

communities.title: Find your people
communities.subtitle: Explore welcoming communities built around shared experiences, where you can connect, learn, and feel less alone.

chronicPain.name: Chronic Pain
chronicPain.description: A supportive space to share experiences, tips, and what helps, offered by people who get it.

crohns.name: Crohn’s & IBD
crohns.description: A welcoming community to talk about daily life, treatment experiences, and navigating ups and downs together.

wellbeing.name: Mental Wellbeing
wellbeing.description: A kind, understanding space to talk about the emotional side of living with a chronic condition.

safety.title: A safe space comes first.
safety.subtitle: Sanad is for peer support and shared experience. It never replaces your doctor.

experience.title: Experience, not prescriptions
experience.body: Stories are personal, never medical advice.

report.title: Report and block
report.body: Step away from anything that feels wrong.

cta.title: You don’t have to do this alone.
cta.subtitle: Find understanding, one conversation at a time.
